_readme: What each tracked call asks for, mapped to answer_bank.json keys for scripts/ops/funding_autofill.py. Limits are copied from the cited source; 'confirm' marks items not yet visible. kind: field (copy a value), choice (pick an option), narrative (write to the limit from the seeds), document (upload).

GAU-103.name: Innovate UK: Efficient, Structured and Controllable AI Systems

items.ask: Project title, start date and duration (1-3 months; start by 1 Apr 2027, end by 30 Jun 2027)
Research category
Project summary
Public description (published if funded; no commercially sensitive information)
Scope: technical novelty and hypothesis-driven experimentation, the technical asset, how it could underpin future products, TRL justification
State aid / subsidy questions
Themes: select one main theme
Applicant location: name and full registered address
Animal testing (Yes/No)
Permits and licences
International collaboration: collaborators, countries, service providers, or confirm none
Export licence (Yes/No)
Trusted Research and Innovation: dual-use, NSI Act areas, export licence status, UK Strategic Export Control List
Intellectual property (IP) position, freedom to operate (FTO) and defensibility
Need, technical development, validation and outputs (optional appendix: 2 A4 pages)
Approach and innovation (optional appendix: 2 A4 pages)
Team and resources
Mandatory appendix: a one-page PDF CV for every project team member (missing CVs cap Q11 at 5)
Market awareness
Wider impacts
Project management
Mandatory appendix: project plan or Gantt chart (PDF, 2 A4 pages)
Risks
Mandatory appendix: risk register (PDF, 2 A4 pages)
Added value
Costs and value for money (total eligible costs GBP 50k-150k)
Project costs, organisation details and funding details
Project Impact questions (not scored)

GAU-105.name: ESA BIC UK (next call ~Q2 2027)
GAU-105.source: ESA BIC UK Issue C templates (Business Plan, Incubation Proposal, Cover Letter and Requirements Checklist, Space Connection Assessment, Tables & Figures)

items.ask: Business Plan: 25 pages maximum including annexes; core ideally 15, maximum 20; remove all blue text
1 Executive Summary (maximum 1 page): opportunity incl. space connection, problem and solution, market, competitive advantage, business model, vision, IP, team
2.1 The Team: founders, leader, supporters
2.2 The Company: date of establishment (under 5 years), legal status, developments during incubation
3 Value Proposition
4.1 The Space Connection (qualifies the application)
4.2 The Technology
4.3 The Readiness Level (see the IRL template)
4.4 R&D strategy
4.5 Intellectual Property: protection and owner
5 Market Analysis: context, demand, segmentation, validation, competition, advantages
6 The Business Model
7 Risk: SWOT and risk analysis
8 Cost Structure, Financing and Financial Projection
Incubation Proposal: maximum 10 pages including cover page and any annexes
1 Activity Proposal: milestone planning (PLAN table) and task descriptions; costs one line per sub-task with each cost shown
2 Management
3 Financing and Funding Request: incentive up to GBP 51,724; no more than 50% on rent, non-UK spend and salaries; FUNDING table
4 Support Request: technical and IPR, business, office
Cover Letter and Requirements Checklist (signed), incl. company details, owners and shareholding, resubmission section
Declaration of Minimal Financial Assistance (threshold GBP 315,000): every line filled, 'N/A' if none
Space Connection Assessment
Tables & Figures workbook (PLAN and FUNDING tables)
Tell the Programme Manager for your location about any support or reasonable adjustments (STFC, 7 Sep 2026)

GAU-104.name: Innovate UK BridgeAI: AI for Decision Critical Systems
GAU-104.source: https://iuk-business-connect.org.uk/?p=138704 (secondary). Questions appear on the Innovation Funding Service when it opens on 21 Oct 2026: confirm then

items.ask: Copy the question list and word limits from IFS on 21 Oct (expect the standard Innovate UK structure, as GAU-103)
Project summary
Team and resources
Market awareness: decision-critical AI users
